childContractVersion.descr: the current version of the child contract

methods.name: new
methods.desc:
Creates a poll for the caller.

The caller is the poll's author. The poll records the author as its `funder` account, and that
account alone may clear the poll's votes once it has ended (`Poll.deleteBoxes`, readiness audit
C17). Anyone may pay for the poll. A payer that is not the author adds `PayerRecordMBR` and is
remembered here, under the new poll's id, so `deletePoll` returns the deposit to the payer and
the author keeps the cleanup (AUD-C24). Before this, a sponsored poll recorded its sponsor as
the `funder`, which handed the cleanup to the sponsor.

methods.name: deletePoll
methods.desc:
Deletes a finished poll whose votes have been cleared and returns its deposit to whoever paid
it: the payer remembered by `new`, or the account the poll records when nobody else paid. A
poll created before AUD-C24 has no payer record and is refunded to its recorded account, as
it always was.

methods.name: optIn

args.name: payment
args.desc: The payment transaction covering MBR for all opt-ins

methods.desc:
optIn opts this contract into `asset`. When this contract has a
named escrow configured (`akitaDAOEscrow.value.name !== ''`), it
also opts the escrow and every revenue-split recipient in through
the revenue-manager plugin — so downstream methods (subscribe,
list, etc.) can transfer to the escrow without doing the plugin-
rekey dance mid-group.

Payment must cover:
  - this contract's own opt-in (1 × assetOptInMinBalance), plus
  - each downstream opt-in the escrow still needs.
`splitOptInCount` returns 0 once the escrow is already opted in, so
the charge collapses to just 1 × assetOptInMinBalance on repeat
calls and the escrow branch becomes a no-op.
